files.root_manual_review: 拥有窗口元数据与生命周期/度量事件；构造器不执行窗口操作。激活原因折为焦点布尔值，空窗口身份getter返回None；影响位只是种类投影，显式RequestRedraw判定不涵盖其它带redraw提示的事件。失焦/应用停用生成All瞬态关闭命令，非客户区点击只关闭PopupStack。Created/Resized提示布局与重绘，Scale变化只提示布局；关闭/销毁清输入和hover，Moved/Occluded/WindowAction提示本身clean。实际应用顺序由窗口泵负责。
五布尔影响DTO；clean全false，单类构造器只设置对应位，链式with_redraw/with_hover_clear累加自身位。方法不驱动宿主操作。原CR-WINDOW-0001 TODO保留，需核实Runtime只消费clears_hover而其余行为沿kind分派的长远契约，不凭重复映射推断已发生产品缺陷。
六个path子模块组成平台输入中间层并重导出四类型；normalize消费拥有事件、生成共享UI输入。窗口度量和光标缓存属于宿主维护的输入上下文，本模块既不维护缓存也不执行分发。

默认上下文及builder保存身份、修饰键和可选缓存；from_window_metadata复制timestamp/sequence/synthetic并克隆window identity，即使空身份仍Some；其余元数据默认且缓存None。手写PartialEq以浮点to_bits比较缓存以支撑Eq，允许相同NaN位模式相等、区分正负零；不强加同一策略给其它DTO。setter没有单位变换或序号推进。旧logical-pixel缓存说明和winit物理位置cast的统一单位尚待调用链证据。
消费self并移走context.metadata与事件载荷；window_metrics/last_cursor_position不进入共享DTO。各分支移动字符串/IME数据，drag payload由Option拥有值转Arc；Touch重写pointer_id/source并用phase映射主按钮动作。无事件顺序、IME范围、坐标单位或浮点有效性校验，无分发副作用。

所有工厂创建拥有的中间DTO。Pointer保留坐标/滚动单位；进入沿Move、离开和capturelost沿Cancel，双击只发clickcount2的Up。key_down/up固定text None，key_char才附字符文本；controller按钮沿keyboard/零代码，analog不归一化。仅ime_with_preedit_clauses显式委托校验，普通IME/byte-range/周边删除不验证文档。drag阶段、popup及tooltip只记录请求；popup_close_requested保留owner且anchor None。touch normalize覆盖context指针身份，force/firstmove工厂忽略force。三处本批新doc的text/owner承诺失准待根修改，原逻辑和原注释均保留。
Owned Rust/Serde tagged-event enum; optional defaults preserved, direct deserialization bypasses checked IME factory, normalization consumes values without validating finite numbers or node identity.
Touch phase mapping is exact: start/down-primary,move/move,end/up-primary,cancel/cancel. No force or gesture semantics; helper visibility remains parent-scoped.
Window metadata becomes input context with caches absent. Cursor move keeps raw position and drops optional delta; cancellation only cursor-left/closed/destroyed using supplied point.
Caller supplies identity,timestamp,sequence; builders sample nothing and validate neither registration nor monotonicity. Synthetic flag is caller data.
Physical dimensions nonnegative u32 and position signed i32; logical,physical,scale are stored without consistency validation. Default zero sizes/scale1 is a DTO placeholder,not a created window.
Exports shared Rust window/input contracts; owns neither native loop nor dispatch. Raw borrowed ABI callers retain memory validity duties until owned conversion ends.

Vec reserve is lower bound,not event limit. Append preserves order; only explicit adjacent-redraw coalescing drops one item without inspecting window/reason. Effects iterator yields commands without executing them.

Copy Rust borrowed view carries caller payload lifetime,not C ABI. Safe new uses caller borrow and only length admission,ignores raw payload pointer. Unsafe raw conversion additionally requires readable,initialized,immutable single-allocation memory.

Single raw wrapper rejects ABI version before borrowing and maps payload-shape errors by event kind; returns owned pump item. Batch consumes in order with iterator lower-bound capacity,first error drops local prefix but cannot undo iterator side effects.

All event-kind branches checked: context supplies routing identity without viewport reconciliation; resized metrics prefer any nonzero new dimension and sanitize scale,zero fallback uses legacy size/scale1. Raw pointer values stay unchanged; mouse wheel discriminates encoded float bits vs legacy coordinates. Keyboard payload decoded before action,scan0 absent,known-name table otherwise decimal. IME plain paths do not validate ranges; disabled produces cancel. Drag payload owned then Arc during normalization; lifecycle low-memory maps focus false. Window scale status retains original numeric value,theme/connection have no equivalent. Accessibility deserializes borrowed bytes into owned request. u32 formatter ten-slot reverse loop terminates at zero.

Full 93 lines reviewed: behavior compares copied bytes/borrowed length and owned accessibility output. Ignored benchmark measures only copy-vs-length fragment,not JSON parse; eleven sorted samples use last item as named p95. No timing execution claimed.

Full 91 lines reviewed: reference append helpers differ solely lower-bound reservation; 256 close events compared by value/order. Ignored timing alternates paths,eleven-sample maximum called p95,no exact capacity or runtime threshold claim.

Full 137 lines reviewed: both physical and logical names compared to formatting references over known/unknown numeric values incl0/u32MAX. Ignored benchmarks measure u32MAX paths,alternate sample order and eleven-sample maximum; no performance execution claim.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Host supplies identity/time/modifiers/context;normalization moves String/Vec payloads and shares drag payload through Arc instead of retaining raw ABI slices. Builders do not validate all semantic invariants or rewrite coordinate units.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.summary: Window metadata/impact and Runtime pump execute different responsibilities
call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Event impact describes hints;actual host paths match event kinds and only directly consume clears_hover among impact fields. Pump coalesces only adjacent same-window redraw requests;input orother events form barriers. Dispatch can mutate lifecycle/metrics/geometry state before later error;no batch rollback is promised.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.summary: ABI value→validated borrowed view→owned platform event→owned pump batch
call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Version/kind/viewport/payload budget andslice shape admit a synchronous borrow but cannot prove memory validity. Unsafe caller must provide initialized/readable immutable bytes within one allocation and nonwrapping range for each actually-read nonempty payload. Adapter output owns decoded strings/requests anddoes not extend borrow lifetime. Conversion-only batch drops its owned prefix on first error;Runtime test dispatch helper commits prefix state separately.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.summary: Checked IME factory performs exact UTF8-byte range admission
call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Only ime_with_preedit_clauses explicitly calls validate_ime_preedit_clauses;cursor checked before clauses. Endpoints must be inbounds UTF8 boundaries;clauses start<=end,ordered andnonoverlapping,zero-length/gaps allowed. No fullcoverage/grapheme/style normalization,document edit or dispatch is performed. Other factories/Serde are not automatically admitted.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.summary: Key/popup documentation corrected to actual arguments and assignments
call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Controller key factories preserve key codes/names andset text None;pressed uses is_repeat. Popup close retains optional owner andsets anchor None. Only task-added inaccurate comment text was replaced;all original documentation preserved.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.summary: Directly mounted perf fixtures exercise narrow allocation/ownership fragments
call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Root read closures/assertions and cfg(test)/ignore mounts. Microbench/test source is not an executed performance result. Four old tool BENCH references are missing andone batch selector fails before assertions;equivalent preexisting failure is preserved,not relabeled as pass.

call_and_lifecycle_findings.summary: Serde/PartialEq and numeric construction retain value semantics
call_and_lifecycle_findings.reason: Context float equality uses bit patterns,including signedzero/NaN payload distinctions,while metrics constructors merely store values. Explicit host/ABI paths sanitize scale only where code does so. Serde defaulting is not a runtime validation/lifetime guarantee.
